The '''Horansi''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the eponymous [[Horansi]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Feline/Legends|felinoids]] indigenous to [[Mutanda]].

==Known words==
*''ad'n'' - "To clean one's toenails."
*''dinn'' - Past participle of ''ad'n''.
